scenes.text: Hello little friend! We're the Shell Heroes Crew, and today we're on a fun adventure about good behavior. Are you ready to join us? We're so excited to explore how being kind and following rules can be awesome! Do you like superheroes? Well, today, you’re going to be one! Let’s dive into our adventure with big smiles and open hearts.

Now, let's talk about what behavior means. Behavior is how we act and respond to things around us. It’s like when you share your toys with a friend or say 'thank you' when someone helps you. These actions show good behavior because they make people happy and help everyone get along. Isn’t that wonderful? When we behave well, we can make the world a better place.

Remember when we talked about sharing toys? Sharing is a superpower! It shows kindness and makes playing together more fun. If you have two toy cars and a friend has none, you can lend one to them. This way, you both can zoom around and have a race! Sharing helps us make friends and have more fun. Would you like to try sharing today?

Great job on thinking about sharing! You’re doing amazing. Now, let’s think about another way to show good behavior. How about saying 'please' and 'thank you'? These words are like magic keys that open doors to kindness. When you say 'please', it shows you’re polite, and 'thank you' tells others you appreciate them. Let’s practice together: Can you say 'please' with me?

Wonderful! You’re really getting the hang of it. Now, let’s talk about listening. Listening is super important because it helps us understand each other. When someone is talking, we stop and pay attention. Like when your teacher is telling a story, you listen to hear all the exciting parts. Listening shows respect and helps us learn new things every day. Isn’t that exciting?

Let’s practice listening now. Imagine we’re in a library where everyone is reading quietly. We use our listening ears to hear the librarian’s gentle voice when she reads a story. Can you pretend to put on your listening ears with me? This helps us hear every word and enjoy the story together. Listening makes our adventures even more fun, don’t you think?

You’re doing a fantastic job! Now, let’s learn about following rules. Rules are like little helpers that keep everyone safe and happy. Like when you’re at the playground, there’s a rule to wait your turn on the slide. This way, everyone gets a chance to slide down and have fun. Following rules makes sure everyone has a good time. Are you ready to be a rule-following hero?

Now let's talk about being a good friend. Being a good friend means being kind and helpful. If your friend is sad, you can cheer them up with a smile or a hug. Or if they need help, you can offer to lend a hand. Being a good friend makes everyone feel happy and cared for. Isn’t it nice to have friends who make you smile?

Let’s practice being a good friend. Imagine your friend is trying to build a tall tower with blocks, but it keeps falling down. You can help by holding the base steady or giving them more blocks. This teamwork helps your friend succeed and makes you both feel proud. Would you like to try being a helpful friend today?

You’re doing great! Let’s remember that everyone makes mistakes, and that’s okay. If you accidentally knock over a friend’s tower, you can say 'I’m sorry' and help rebuild it. Apologizing shows you care and want to make things right. We all learn from mistakes and become better friends. Isn’t that a great way to grow?

Now, do you remember a time when you showed good behavior? Maybe you helped clean up your toys or shared your crayons. How did it make you feel? Did it make others smile too? Think about it and let’s chat about your hero moments. We’d love to hear your stories!

Those are some amazing stories! Now, let's talk about staying calm when things don’t go as planned. Sometimes we feel upset, and that’s okay too. Taking deep breaths can help us feel better. Let’s try it together: breathe in slowly through your nose and out through your mouth. Doesn’t that feel nice? Staying calm helps us think clearly and make good choices.

Let’s practice staying calm in a fun way. Imagine you’re holding a balloon. When you breathe in, the balloon gets bigger, and when you breathe out, it gets smaller. Let’s do it together: breathe in and out. This helps us feel relaxed and ready to handle anything. Would you like to practice this whenever you feel upset?

You're doing such an amazing job! Remember, practicing good behavior makes us feel like superheroes every day. Whether it’s sharing, listening, or staying calm, every little action counts. You’re learning so much, and we’re really proud of you! Keep up the great work, and you’ll continue to shine bright.

Thank you for joining us on this adventure about behavior. You’re a real hero in the making! Keep practicing all the wonderful things we talked about today. Remember, every day is a new chance to be kind and helpful. We can’t wait to see how amazing you’ll become. Goodbye for now, and keep being awesome!
